settings.form_info:
Email us at hello@soilboy.sg or fill out the form. Our lean & green team, will respond between 1-3 business days.

Looking for corporate gifts, workshops or installations? Email us at business@soilboy.sg or indicate your project details in the form.

Need personalised guidance with your plants or order? Reach out to our PlantCare team for one-on-one support designed around your plants’ needs.
